name: Wedding Dress
description: During the next year, Nishang Pavilion was famous throughout the country for its clothing craftsmanship. It not only customized clothes for nobles, but also provided special clothes for the palace. The master of the pavilion loved his fiancée so much that he customized an exquisite wedding dress for her before the wedding, which caused a sensation in the whole city. The wedding dress was jointly made by several embroidery masters. It has a red brocade base, with a flying phoenix on the top and sea water and river cliffs on the bottom. The edges are decorated with gold patterns. The skirt reaches three feet to the ground, swaying and beautiful. The phoenix crown and harem, and the ten miles of red makeup are the most beautiful commitment to love. Give your lover a wedding dress and promise her a lifelong love.
